# GreenShield

> AI-Powered Renewable Energy Verification and REC Fraud Intelligence.

GreenShield makes Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) fraud detectable by construction. Every certificate carries cryptographic proof hidden inside pixel LSBs, verified against AI generation expectations and an immutable ledger.

## Portals & Tools
- [Landing Page](http://localhost:5174/): Platform overview, system architecture, and entry points.
- [Public REC Verifier](http://localhost:5174/verifier): Three-layer public certificate authenticity and integrity verifier.
- [Government Portal](http://localhost:5174/government/dashboard): Verification dashboard, case investigations, and fraud intelligence network.
- [Generator Portal](http://localhost:5174/generator/dashboard): Generation data logging, plant profile, and AI generation forecasts.
- [Institution Portal](http://localhost:5174/institution/dashboard): Clean energy claim submission, certificate inventory, and ESG compliance.
